papers.title: PreWAM: Exploring the Design of Latent Future Prediction for World-Action Modeling
papers.abstract: World-action models combine action generation with future prediction, allowing visual transitions to serve as supervision for policy learning. Our controlled study of prediction spaces shows that spatially structured semantic features support better overall generalization under visual perturbations
